scope: Read-only aggregation; no training, new predictions, selection, threshold changes or application acceptance.

definitions.primary: grid48; z32 primary; all three model seeds, FFT has no training seed
definitions.coverage: Assigned evaluated grid windows / evaluated windows with full support; not molecule detection accuracy or material area.
definitions.before: Feature/relation components before order and connected-size refusals.
definitions.after: Candidate domains after frozen order gate and connected-size filtering.
definitions.boundaries: Only four contacting positive-domain synthetic cases; tolerance 8 reference pixels; never exact TTMAPP contours.
definitions.uncertainty: Ranges across the three seeds, not confidence intervals; one correlated acquisition.
definitions.control_counts: For learned models: 3 model seeds x 3 control realizations = 9 assessments per case. FFT: 3 realizations. No pooling into independent acquisitions.
definitions.transfer: Same-acquisition spatially held-out test graph only. Partial BLACK/RED; absent YELLOW remains null.
definitions.transductive: Whole available partial-reference interiors; distinct denominator and inference scope.
definitions.matched: Frozen ACF ranking and achieved assignment intersection only; common coverage below 0.20 or a missing pair kind makes error gain unavailable.
definitions.control_reuse: 21/22 original81 are development evidence after viewing in21. Fresh21a controls use separate realizations of known families.

consistency.interpretation: Model seeds are not independent control realizations or acquisitions.

detailed_tables: tables.md and CSV files in the output directory; all seeds retained in comparison.json
